purpose: per-cell raw counts for C7 and the whole-tissue-specific Stro-7 genes, with library size, cluster, section and donor — the inputs for a pseudobulk comparison of cluster 3 against the rest
STATS_NOTE: cells within a section are not independent replicates; a cell-level test over 47,533 cells is pseudoreplication and its p-value is meaningless. The sections are the replicates (6, from 2 donors), so the comparison is paired across sections on pseudobulk CPM, with detection rate as a distribution-free companion. The true biological n is 2 donors — serial sections of one block are not independent biological replicates.
